comment: Factory selection of blessed LLM models for octo-llm.
super_admin chooses from this set via Settings → System.
Three tiers covering the operator-experience spectrum:
Adding an entry requires the model file from a trusted source,
the sha256 of that exact file (pinned in this manifest), and a
code review. sha256: null entries are downloadable only via the
BYOM path (scp into models dir) until a code review pins the
hash here. Slice 5d-4 (the in-product download broker) is what
Note (2026-06-02): Granite is sourced from bartowski's GGUF mirror
because the upstream ibm-granite GGUF repo is HF-gated (401). The
pinned sha256 is identical across both — it's the same file — so the
switch is verified, not a re-pin.

models.name: tinyllama-1.1b-chat
models.description: 1.1B parameters. Fast on CPU, low quality. For pipeline + UI validation; quality is too low for production triage.

models.name: qwen-2.5-3b-q4
models.description: 3B parameters. Good instruction follower; reasonable triage notes on modest CPU. Recommended default for MSP deployments without GPU.

models.name: granite-3.1-8b-q4
models.description: 8B parameters. Higher-fidelity triage; slower per call. Best when deployed on hosts with 16GB+ RAM headroom for octo-llm.
